name: Double Bacon Cheeseburger with Crinkle Waffle Fries
whyItWorks: Two fatty beef patties smothered in melted cheddar, thick bacon strips, burger sauce, and served with a basket of deep-fried waffle fries. Packs over 55g of fat that heavily stresses digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fat Warning: Choose the plain grilled chicken breast sandwich or a single hamburger patty instead.
